skills.description: GENERALIZES the Care Router's behavioral-health-handoff into a full outbound-referral node: what the router expresses as one handoff pathway, this agent expresses as a catalog of cosign-gated referral drafts across the menopause care neighborhood

skills.name: Triage is DETERMINISTIC (a pure function of the age/cycle...
skills.description: Triage is DETERMINISTIC (a pure function of the age/cycle/symptom/severity/red-flag context + risk flags; no randomness, no clock) — the same context always yields the same recommended referral(s)

skills.name: Every recommended referral references a defined specialty...
skills.description: Every recommended referral references a defined specialty-catalog id AND carries a documented reason — never a fabricated or reasonless referral; enforced at the Agent Fabric governance boundary
